rows.name: Fewer signals
rows.assumption: facility.enter gather 1300 -> 715 ms (the summoner's flight, 55%, stays; the three beacon pulses and bearing go). Other cut effects cost no schedule time: a floor, E1's value is attention. Built (E1): today's rules already have it, so this row reads 0; see *Built*.

rows.name: Labels on arrival
rows.assumption: Built (E2): today's rules already have it, so this row reads about 0; see the build record. A P-6 wait starts tell + gather of its own earlier (it travels while waiting, claims its labels at its act). No budget re-fit. An upper bound: it releases only the binding predecessor, so a wait also held by another constraint would start later.

rows.name: Progress beam (enabler)
rows.assumption: Enabler: used by E5, which carries the saving; alone it costs no schedule time.

rows.name: Transform from gather (U1)
rows.assumption: Built (E4a): today's rules already have it, so this row reads about 0; see *Built*. A first merge's 4.4 s transform starts at its gather and the station fires as it ends: tell 300, gather 900, act 2300, land 500, echo 3000, disperse 900, holds the facility (3.2 s saved per first merge; C2 modelled act 3500, 2.0 s).

rows.name: Overlap neighbours (P3)
rows.assumption: Built (E4b): today's rules already have it, so this row reads about 0; see *Built*. Any residual is a wait the part does not cover (a wait on attention places, or on a shared actor). P-4 and P-6 waits start min(predecessor echo + disperse, own tell + gather) earlier (P-3 and P-5 share an actor, which P3 forbids). No budget re-fit. An upper bound: it releases only the binding predecessor, so a wait also held by another constraint would start later.

rows.name: Captain waits near (P4)
rows.assumption: Built (E4c): today's rules already have it, so this row reads about 0; see *Built*. Any residual is a wait the part does not cover (a wait on a protected pair, or on the attention budget). A P-5 wait starts (predecessor end - its crew close) earlier, floored at 0: the captain waits near instead of leaving. No budget re-fit. An upper bound: it releases only the binding predecessor, so a wait also held by another constraint would start later.

rows.name: Short forms (P7)
rows.assumption: Built (E4d): the short forms exist, unused until E5; see *Built* for the real ceiling. A ceiling (the director picks which): every protected rule and its variants has each phase x 0.6, except a close's land; the captain's plate minimums still floor it.

rows.name: The director
rows.assumption: Built (E5a): the pass picks each moment's form; see *Built*. Modelled here: merges with no arc close, minus each author's first merge and each day's climax, become a 1.5 s progress beam. Trade-down and the target are not modelled: E5 + E4d is its ceiling.
rows.detail: 1 of 7 merges replaced by a 1.5 s beam

rows.name: Multi-fire volleys
rows.assumption: Built (E6): merges into one facility within 20 s of x on one day play as one volley, under the B-15 guard; see *Built*. Modelled here: per facility, merges within 10 s of a group's first (same day) play only their split beam (echo 1500 ms, no gather, no held turn). The union formation's labels are not modelled.

rows.name: Sector sweep
rows.assumption: A lower bound (within a beat only): the first of n >= 2 creations sweeps (tell 300, act 900 + 250 x (n-1), echo 400) and the others are dropped. Built (E7): a beat with 4 or more creations plays one Sector sweep (tell 300, act min(2000, 110 x n) + 1000, echo 400); see *Built*.

rows.name: Tighter frame
rows.assumption: Day turns keep 0.6 of themselves, last-day gaps and the tail gap 0.7, floored at 500 ms. Expected 0 s: every pod is over budget and already squeezed to 500 ms. Widening early days is ignored.

rows.name: Tighter frame (floor 250 ms)
